title: Corinthians vs. Fluminense: A Duel of Pressures and History
seoTitle: Corinthians vs. Fluminense: Pressures and History Clash
subtitle: The clash brings together Brasileirão challenges and an old rivalry
excerpt: The clash between Corinthians and Fluminense, set for Sunday at 4 PM, draws attention due to Corinthians' post-Libertadores pressure and the teams' rich history.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Corinthians and Fluminense, scheduled for Sunday, 20th, at 4 PM, draws attention due to Corinthians' pressure after their Libertadores elimination and the history between the teams, especially with Fernando Diniz. The match will be broadcast by Globo and Premiere.

Pressure on Corinthians After Libertadores Elimination

Corinthians arrives at the duel under intense pressure. The team was eliminated from the Libertadores on Wednesday after losing 1-0 to Estudiantes at home, following a 1-1 draw in Argentina. Memphis Depay missed a penalty in the final moments. In the Brasileirão, the situation is also concerning: they have five consecutive defeats and only a four-point lead over the relegation zone.

Fernando Diniz and His History with Fluminense

Sunday's game pits two old acquaintances against each other: Fluminense and coach Fernando Diniz, champion of the Libertadores, Recopa Sudamericana, and Campeonato Carioca with the Tricolor team. This will be the coach's first contact, now with Corinthians, with his former club, but his second against Flu in 2026. In February, Diniz's Vasco lost to Zubeldía's squad, and he was fired right after the match. ge compiled the coach's record against Fluminense after his two stints with the Rio de Janeiro team. There were ten games in total, with six victories for Flu against four triumphs for the coach.

Fluminense's Structure and Focus on the National Championship

Despite a 2-1 defeat to Platense on Tuesday, Fluminense advanced to the Libertadores semifinals thanks to a 2-0 victory in the first leg. In the Brasileirão, Marcão's team attempts to react after losing 3-1 to Atlético-MG in the previous round. Marcão is expected to maintain the structure he has been using in recent matches, with Fábio in goal and Hulk as the main offensive reference. Canobbio and Savarino are expected to play on the wings, while Martinelli, Nonato, and Acosta form the midfield.

Probable Lineups and Officiating

Corinthians: Hugo Souza; Matheuzinho, Gabriel Paulista, Gustavo Henrique, and Matheus Bidu; Allan, Raniele, Breno Bidon, and Rodrigo Garro; Kaio César and Memphis Depay. Coach: Fernando Diniz.Fluminense: Fábio; Guga, Igor Rabello, Freytes, and Guilherme Arana; Martinelli, Nonato, and Acosta; Canobbio, Savarino, and Hulk. Coach: Marcão.Officiating: Ramon Abatti Abel (SC); Assistants: Nailton Junior de Sousa Oliveira (CE) and Henrique Neu Ribeiro (SC); Fourth official: Gustavo Ervino Bauermann (SC); VAR: Daniel Nobre Bins (RS); AVAR: Andre da Silva Bitencourt (RS); AVAR2: Marcello Ignacio Domingues Neto (RS).

Where to Watch Live

The match will be broadcast live by Globo and Premiere.

With information from VEJA, ge.
